content: A massive street festival in Asheville held in August. A backdrop for intense social maneuvering and potential Masquerade breaches due to the crowds.

title: Kemintiri (Red List)
content: The subject of the upcoming 2025 Judicial Conclave in London. The conclave will debate her removal from the #1 spot on the Red List.

title: FBI Incursion (Sept 2025)
content: The arrival of federal agents in Asheville, prompting Prince Daveed to order Erecura to alter her appearance to avoid the Second Inquisition.

title: Ophelia's Sheriffdom
content: The brief period in early 2025 where Ophelia (Malkavian) served as Sheriff after Oliver's disappearance and before Manfred took the role.

title: Shimmer (Brujah)
content: Former Seneschal to Tallula in late 2024/early 2025. Destroyed by Tallula after a failed assassination/coup attempt.

title: Michael Valentine (Keeper)
content: The Brujah Keeper of Elysium appointed in August 2025. He introduced the 'Steward' system for Elysium staff.

title: Grant Smalls
content: Tremere Neonate appointed as the first Steward of Elysium by Michael Valentine.

title: Damien Natosa's Fashion Symbel
content: A contest held by the Elder Tzimisce/Ventrue Damien Natosa to update his wardrobe after waking from torpor.

title: Treaty of the Land of the Sky (1991)
content: The founding document of the Camarilla domain, overseen by Elder Volshebnik. It granted seats to 7 clans and established the Basilica as Elysium.

title: Highland Hospital
content: The site of the 1948 fire used to cover up Zelda Fitzgerald's embrace. A location of historical trauma.

title: The Amphitheater
content: The ritual combat arena located within the NC Arboretum Elysium. Used for duels and executions (like the 2001 Brujah Primogen execution).

title: Zephyr's Breach (March 2025)
content: The massive Masquerade breach at Crossroads Studio caused by the singer Zephyr. Resulted in a fire and significant scrutiny.

title: Operation: Fight Club
content: A rumored (and denied) Symbel Ordeal for combat that Jack Greenlimb teased in Feb 2025.

title: Uno (Janus's Game)
content: A card game brought to Elysium by the Elder Janus. He stated people could play without him if he wasn't at the table.

title: Basillia (Justicar)
content: The Gangrel Justicar appointed/confirmed in 2023 after the clan's return to the Tower.

title: Juliet Parr (Justicar)
content: The Malkavian Justicar. Sheriff of London. Presiding over the 2025 Conclave regarding Kemintiri.

title: Tegyrius (Justicar)
content: The Banu Haqim Justicar. A former Vizier who led the schismatics into the Camarilla.

title: Cock Robin (Justicar)
content: The Nosferatu Justicar. Confirmed in the 2023 post-Conclave shuffle.

title: Lucinde (Justicar)
content: The Ventrue Justicar and Alastor. One of the most powerful Kindred in the Camarilla.

title: Ulugh Begh (Justicar)
content: The Tremere Justicar. Known for a hardline stance against the Sabbat. His Archon Ferrum Civis died in Asheville.

title: Madame Guil (Justicar)
content: The Toreador Justicar. An ally of Tallula Donegan who protected the domain from scrutiny for years.

title: Theo Bell (Justicar)
content: The Brujah Justicar. Famous for killing Hardestadt. Represents the 'Loyalist' Brujah.

title: Imperator Karsh
content: The Warlord of the Camarilla who vanished in 2023, leaving a power vacuum in the military leadership.

title: Anarch Revolt (Argentina)
content: Reference to the defection of Ana Maria Alverez and the fall of Rosario to the Anarchs in late 2024.

title: The Independent Alliance
content: A faction (Setites, Giovanni, etc.) that ratified a decision in Las Vegas (Sept 2025) to attack the Sabbat.

title: Palla Grande Offensive (2025)
content: A coordinated strike by the Independent Alliance against Sabbat strongholds (Atlanta, Savannah) on Halloween 2025.

title: Judicial Conclave
content: A high-level Camarilla court meeting to decide major laws or judge high-profile cases (like the Red List).

title: Grand Conclave
content: The highest gathering of the Camarilla, occurring rarely (last in 2023), where Justicars are chosen.

title: Monomacy
content: Ritual duel for leadership or grievance resolution, used by the Sabbat (and occasionally Asheville Kindred).

title: Diocese of WNC
content: The Sabbat organizational term for Western North Carolina.

title: Land of the Sky
content: The poetic name for the Asheville domain, used in treaties and titles.

title: The Ivory Tower
content: Metaphor for the Camarilla.

title: The Sword of Caine
content: Metaphor for the Sabbat.

title: Lupine War
content: The ongoing conflict between Asheville Kindred and the Garou, flaring up in 1900 and again in 2024.

title: Pentex
content: A mega-corporation mentioned in 1888 history as working with George Vanderbilt. Enemy of the Garou.

title: George Vanderbilt
content: Mortal tycoon whose estate purchase in 1888 catalyzed the Kindred population of Asheville.

title: Industrial Revolution
content: The era that allowed vampires to finally settle the 'urban valleys' of the mountains in numbers.

title: Cross-Appalachian Travel
content: The strategic goal of the Sabbat in 1910—to control the mountain passes for movement.

title: The Great Fire of London (1666)
content: Historical event mentioned in Tallula's backstory that ruined her family.

title: Julie d’Aubigny (La Maupin)
content: Historical figure cited as the 'vibe' for Tallula Donegan.

title: Highland Hospital
content: Site of Zelda Fitzgerald's death/embrace.

title: Basilica of St. Lawrence
content: Established as Elysium in 1991. The primary court location.

title: Primogen Council
content: The ruling council of the domain. Composition has shifted over the years (Gangrel out/in, Banu Haqim in).

title: Black Mountain
content: Outlying town mentioned as a Sabbat stronghold in 1991 and present day.

title: Waynesville
content: Outlying town mentioned as a Sabbat stronghold.

title: The Harpy's Ledger
content: The record of boons and status maintained by the Harpy.

title: Second Inquisition
content: The modern threat of government hunters (FBI/NSA).

title: Gehenna Cults
content: Cults predicting the end of the world, cracked down upon by Tallula in 1999.

title: Path of Honorable Accord
content: The Path of Enlightenment Tallula followed before switching to Humanity in 2002.

title: Autark
content: A vampire outside the sect system. Johannan Wilder was one before 2011.

title: Schismatics
content: The faction of Banu Haqim that split from Alamut to join the Camarilla.

title: Vizier
content: A caste of Banu Haqim focused on administration and scholarship (e.g., Magda Doluda).

title: Warrior
content: A caste of Banu Haqim focused on combat (e.g., Daveed Fourié).

title: Sorcerer
content: A caste of Banu Haqim focused on blood magic.

title: Anathema
content: Another name for the Red List.

title: Kindred Involvement (1888)
content: The start of significant vampire activity in WNC.

title: War with Lupines (1900)
content: The first major war securing the domain.

title: Sabbat Join the Fight (1910)
content: The Sabbat's entry into the local conflict.

title: Land of the Sky Falls (1914)
content: The conquest of Asheville by the Sabbat.

title: Unsteady Truce (1914)
content: The agreement between Sabbat and Lupines.

title: Grove Arcade Finished (1929)
content: Completion of the major skyscraper.

title: Treaty of Land of the Sky (1991)
content: The return of the domain to the Camarilla.

title: First Assassination Attempt (1992)
content: Black Hand attack on Tallula.

title: Red Star Shines (1999)
content: The omen of Gehenna.

title: Schismatics Find a Seat (2000)
content: Banu Haqim entry to council.

title: Arboretum becomes Elysium (2001)
content: Expansion of domain territory.

title: Change is here to stay (2002)
content: Tallula's path change.

title: Gangrel Return (2011)
content: Reinstatement of Gangrel Primogen.

title: Grand Conclave (2023)
content: Global Camarilla shifts.

title: The City of Enoch
content: The First City, built by Caine and his childer. A place where mortals and vampires lived in peace before the Great Deluge destroyed it. Caine ruled here as King.

title: The Second City
content: Built by the Antediluvians after the Flood in defiance of Caine. It was rife with betrayal and eventually destroyed when the Brujah founder Troile committed diablerie against their sire.

title: Carthage
content: The ancient city of the Brujah, where vampires lived openly with mortals. It was destroyed by the Ventrue and Roman armies, who salted the earth to bind the infernalists believed to hide there.

title: Kaymakli
content: The underground city in Turkey where Cappadocius held the 'Feast of Folly', sealing thousands of his 'unworthy' childer in the tunnels to starve or fall to the Beast.

title: Chorazin
content: The accursed city of the Baali. Believed to be where the infernalist clan retreats to worship their dark masters and await Gehenna.

title: Convention of Thorns (1493)
content: The treaty signed at the Abbey of the Sacred Crown that ended the first Anarch Revolt. It officially formed the Camarilla and forced the Anarchs to join or flee (becoming the Sabbat).

title: The Promise of 1528
content: The non-interference treaty between the Camarilla and Clan Giovanni. The Giovanni agreed to stay out of sect politics in exchange for sovereignty over Venice and free trade.

title: Code of Milan
content: The governing document of the Sabbat, emphasizing the duality of freedom and loyalty. It was adopted to stabilize the sect during civil wars in the New World.

title: Status Perfectus
content: The founding document of the Anarch Free States in California. It attempted to apply modern democratic principles to vampiric society, rejecting the feudal Prince system.

title: The Shadow Curtain
content: A mystical barrier erected by the Nosferatu Methuselah Baba Yaga over Eastern Europe (Russia), isolating it from the rest of the vampiric world for decades.

title: Nictuku
content: Monstrous vampires created by the Nosferatu Antediluvian to hunt down and destroy his own clan. They are the boogeymen of the Sewer Rats.

title: Week of Nightmares (1999)
content: The apocalyptic event in Bangladesh where the Ravnos Antediluvian awoke. The resulting psychic backlash drove the Ravnos clan mad, leading to their near-extinction.

title: Cainite Heresy
content: A Gnostic belief from the Dark Ages claiming vampires were angels sent by God to rule over mortals. It infiltrated the Church before being crushed by the Inquisition.

title: Euagetaematikon
content: The 'Book of Blood'. The sacred text of the Cainite Heresy.

title: The Great Prank
content: The event in the late 20th century where the Malkavian Elders restored the discipline of Dementation to the clan, replacing Dominate for most members.

title: Knights of the Moon
content: A faction of Malkavians who resisted the Great Prank. They retain the discipline of Dominate and often manifest insanity as cold sociopathy rather than manic delusion.

title: Schismatics
content: The faction of Assamites (Viziers and Sorcerers) who fled Alamut and the madness of ur-Shulgi to seek sanctuary in the Camarilla.

title: Laibon
content: The vampires of Africa. They possess distinct lineages (legacies) and govern themselves under the Ebony Kingdom, separate from the Camarilla and Sabbat.

title: Guruhi
content: A Laibon lineage of kings and land-rulers in Africa. They blend ancient tradition with modern corporate engineering.

title: Ishtarri
content: A Laibon lineage (and Toreador bloodline) of diplomats, spies, and hedonists. They are known for their beauty and dual nature.

title: Osebo
content: A Laibon lineage of warriors. They are often associated with the Beast and serve as the guardians of the Ebony Kingdom.

title: Angellis Ater
content: The 'Black Angels'. A bloodline of Lasombra who turned to infernalism and joined the Baali. They combine Obtenebration with Daimoinon.

title: Telyav
content: A bloodline of Lithuanian Tremere who practiced animistic magic and rejected the Pyramid. They were believed destroyed but hide among the Sabbat.

title: Premascine
content: A Giovanni bloodline that acts as a throwback to the Cappadocians. They can learn the Mortis Path of Necromancy and often appear corpse-like.

title: Szlachta
content: War ghouls created by the Tzimisce using Vicissitude. They are lobotomized, armored with bone, and armed with bone-spurs.

title: Gargoyles
content: A slave race created by the Tremere from the body parts of Gangrel, Nosferatu, and Tzimisce to fight in the Gargoyle Revolt. Now a free bloodline.

title: Harbingers of Skulls
content: The remnants of the Cappadocian clan who returned from the Shadowlands (or Kaymakli) to join the Sabbat. They wear masks to hide their skull-like faces.

title: Salubri Healers (Lambs)
content: The original caste of the Salubri clan. Persecuted by the Tremere, they seek Golconda and practice the healing art of Obeah.

title: Salubri Warriors
content: The caste of Salubri who turned to war to survive. They joined the Sabbat and practice the discipline of Valeren (burning righteous fire).

title: Daughters of Cacophony
content: A bloodline known for their supernatural voices (Melpominee). They are often called 'Sirens' and can shatter minds or objects with song.

title: Samedi
content: A bloodline of rotting necromancers. They resemble zombies and practice Thanatosis (decay). They often work as mercenaries.

title: Lhiannan
content: A rare, druidic bloodline of the Gangrel (or independent) linked to spirit magic (Ogham). They are hunted and nearly extinct.

title: Kiasyd
content: The 'Weirdlings'. A Sabbat bloodline created from Lasombra experimentation with Fae blood. They are tall, pale scholars who study the Abyss and Arcadia.

title: Nagaraja
content: A bloodline of flesh-eating necromancers. They possess sharp teeth and must consume human flesh in addition to blood.

title: True Brujah
content: A bloodline claiming to be the true descendants of the Antediluvian Brujah, viewing the main clan as rebels who killed their sire. They master Time (Temporis).

title: Inner Circle
content: The true ruling body of the Camarilla. A group of Elders (one from each clan) who meet every 13 years to set policy and appoint Justicars. They remain anonymous.

title: Justicar
content: The judges and enforcers of the Inner Circle. There is one for each pillar clan. They have absolute authority to enforce the Traditions and command Archons.

title: Archon
content: A high-ranking agent of a Justicar. They travel the world enforcing Camarilla law and investigating threats.

title: Alastor
content: A specialized Archon or agent dedicated solely to hunting those on the Red List (The Anathema). They carry a 'Trophy' tattoo.

title: The Red List
content: A list of the most wanted criminals in the Camarilla. Vampires on this list are 'Anathema' and must be destroyed by any Camarilla member on sight.

title: Trophy
content: The physical mark (tattoo) carried by an Alastor, identifying them as a hunter of the Red List.

title: Auctoritas Ritae
content: The High Rituals of the Sabbat. Thirteen rituals (like the Vaulderie, Creation Rites, Monomacy) practiced by the entire sect to ensure loyalty and unity.

title: Ignoblis Ritae
content: The Low Rituals of the Sabbat. Custom rituals created by individual packs to bond them together. Unique to each pack.

title: Vaulderie
content: The defining rite of the Sabbat. A communal blood-drinking ritual that breaks existing blood bonds and creates a 'Vinculum' (loyalty tie) to the pack.

title: Monomacy
content: The Sabbat rite of ritual duel. Used to settle grievances or challenge leadership positions. The winner is often entitled to diablerize the loser.

title: Creation Rites
content: The Sabbat method of Embrace. Often involves 'shovelheading'—draining a victim, bashing them with a shovel, and burying them to claw their way out.

title: Palla Grande
content: The Grand Ball. A major Sabbat festival held on Halloween (or Walpurgis Night). A mockery of Camarilla court involving excess and a blood feast.

title: War Party
content: A Sabbat rite where a pack hunts a specific potent enemy (usually an Elder) to diablerize them.

title: Wild Hunt
content: A Sabbat rite where the sect hunts down a traitor who has revealed Sabbat secrets. The traitor is usually staked and burned.

title: Fire Dance
content: A Sabbat rite where vampires prove their bravery by jumping through fire. Builds courage against Rötschreck.

title: Games of Instinct
content: Sabbat 'sports' used to hone predatory skills. Examples include 'Cowboys and Indians' (hunting mortals) or 'Demolition Derby'.

title: Sermon of Caine
content: The Sabbat rite of reading from the Book of Nod to remind the pack of their history and holy purpose.

title: Regent
content: The spiritual and temporal leader of the entire Sabbat sect. Believed to rule in Caine's stead.

title: Cardinal
content: A high-ranking Sabbat leader overseeing a vast geographic region (like the East Coast). They coordinate the war effort.

title: Archbishop
content: The ruler of a Sabbat city. Equivalent to a Camarilla Prince, but often more of a spiritual and military commander.

title: Bishop
content: A Sabbat leader who advises the Archbishop or oversees a specific aspect of the city (e.g., Bishop of War, Bishop of Rituals).

title: Ductus
content: The leader of a Sabbat pack. Responsible for tactics and logistics.

title: Priest (Sabbat)
content: The spiritual leader of a Sabbat pack. Responsible for conducting Ritae and maintaining morale.

title: Templar (Paladin)
content: An elite Sabbat warrior sworn to protect a Bishop, Archbishop, or Cardinal.

title: Black Hand
content: The 'Lost Tribe'. A secret military order within the Sabbat (and beyond) dedicated to the service of the Antediluvians (or Caine, depending on the faction).

title: Loyalists
content: A Sabbat faction that believes in absolute freedom. They reject hierarchy and only obey Caine's direct commands (which are none).

title: Ultra-Conservatives
content: A Sabbat faction that favors strict centralization and military discipline to win the Gehenna War.

title: Status Quo
content: The Sabbat faction that seeks to maintain the current power structure of the sect (Lasombra/Tzimisce leadership).

title: Pander
content: The Clanless of the Sabbat. Led by Joseph Pander, they fought for recognition as a legitimate 'clan' within the sect.

title: Sweeper
content: An Anarch title for a vampire who introduces newcomers to the domain and ensures they know the local rules.

title: Agitator
content: An Anarch title for a vampire who stirs up debate and questions the status quo to keep the movement honest.

title: The Baronies
content: The territories within an Anarch Free State, ruled by individual Barons.

title: Consistory
content: The council of Cardinals and Prisci that advises the Regent of the Sabbat.

title: Priscus
content: An advisor in the Sabbat with great status but no temporal command. They advise the Consistory.

title: Noddism
content: The study of the Book of Nod and the history of Caine. Central to Sabbat theology.

title: Path of Enlightenment
content: An alternative moral code to Humanity, used by Sabbat and Elders to control the Beast. Examples: Path of Caine, Path of Lilith, Path of Night.

title: Prince (Praxis Holder)
content: The supreme ruler of a Camarilla domain. They hold the right of Praxis, the authority to create progeny, judge disputes, and call Blood Hunts. Their word is law within the city limits.

title: Seneschal
content: The Prince's second-in-command and chamberlain. They oversee the nightly operations of the domain, manage the Prince's schedule, and act as ruler when the Prince is unavailable or torpid.

title: Harpy
content: The arbiter of social status and scandal. They maintain the ledger of boons, announce who is 'in' or 'out' of favor, and punish social faux pas with status bans like 'Vulgar' or 'Disgraced'.

title: Sheriff
content: The martial enforcer of the Prince's will. Responsible for physical security, investigating crimes against the Traditions, and hunting down enemies of the domain. They may appoint Deputies to assist them.

title: Keeper of Elysium
content: The guardian of the domain's most sacred grounds. They ensure the sanctity of Elysium, confiscate weapons, and manage the comfort and entertainment of guests. They have absolute authority within the Elysium's walls.

title: Scourge
content: A controversial position tasked with population control. They hunt down and destroy the 'unwanted': Caitiff, thin-bloods, and unauthorized neonates who have not been presented to the Prince.

title: Primogen
content: A member of the council of elders that advises the Prince. Typically, there is one Primogen for each 'Pillar Clan' in the city. They represent their clan's interests and check the Prince's power.

title: Whip
content: The assistant and enforcer for a Primogen. They keep the clan members in line, communicate the Primogen's orders, and act as a proxy in council meetings when the Primogen is absent.

title: Justicar
content: One of the supreme judges of the Camarilla, elected by the Inner Circle to a 13-year term. There is one Justicar for each clan. They have the power to depose Princes and command the entire sect's resources.

title: Archon
content: An agent and deputy of a Justicar. They travel the world enforcing the Justicar's will, investigating corruption, and hunting the Red List. They carry the full authority of their patron.

title: Alastor
content: A specialized Archon or hunter dedicated solely to pursuing those on the 'Red List' (the Anathema). They are marked with a magical tattoo (The Trophy) and have global authority to command assistance.

title: Inner Circle
content: The secretive ruling body of the entire Camarilla. Composed of the eldest members of each clan, they meet every 13 years in Venice to set global policy and appoint Justicars.

title: Imperator
content: A rare military title for the supreme commander of the Camarilla's forces during times of great war. Karsh is the most famous Imperator.

title: Praxis
content: The claim of right to rule a domain. A Prince 'claims Praxis' to establish their sovereignty. It must be backed by the ability to enforce it and the recognition of the court.

title: Domain
content: The physical territory claimed by a Prince or granted to a vassal. The holder of a domain has the right to feed within it and restrict access to others.

title: Elysium
content: A designated location where violence is strictly forbidden. It is a neutral ground for art, politics, and socialization. Breaching the peace of Elysium is a capital offense.

title: The Rack
content: The prime feeding grounds of a city (e.g., club districts). Access to the Rack is a privilege granted by the Prince, often reserved for Elders and Primogen.

title: Hound
content: A slang term or official title for a Deputy Sheriff. They assist the Sheriff in patrolling the domain and subduing criminals.

title: Deputy
content: An assistant to an official (Sheriff, Scourge, Keeper). They derive their authority from their superior and serve at their pleasure.

title: Chancellor
content: A title sometimes used for the Keeper of records or a high-ranking advisor who manages the city's mortal influence and bureaucracy.

title: Herald
content: A messenger of the Prince. They deliver proclamations, summons, and warnings to the Kindred of the city. In some courts, this role is merged with the Harpy or Seneschal.

title: Ambassador
content: A representative from another domain or sect (rarely). They negotiate treaties and maintain diplomatic channels.

title: Consul
content: A representative of the Camarilla sent to a non-Camarilla city (like an Anarch Free State) to act as a liaison and observer.

title: Prince's Court
content: The collective body of officers and acknowledged Kindred who attend the Prince's gatherings. It is the center of social and political life.

title: Acknowledged
content: A status trait indicating a neonate has been accepted by the Prince as a full member of Camarilla society. Without it, a vampire has no rights.

title: Unacknowledged
content: A vampire who has not been presented to or accepted by the Prince. They are effectively non-citizens and have no protection under the Traditions.

title: Fledgling
content: A young vampire who is still under the accounting of their sire. They are not yet independent and their sire is responsible for their actions.

title: Neonate
content: A young vampire (typically <50 years active) who has been released/acknowledged but has not yet earned the rank of Ancilla.

title: Ancilla
content: A vampire of intermediate age and status (typically 50-300 years). They serve as the ambitious middle management of the sect, aiming for Elder status.

title: Elder
content: A vampire of significant age (300+ years) and power. They hold the highest positions and command the most respect (and fear).

title: Methuselah
content: A vampire of incredible age (1000+ years), often of the 4th or 5th generation. They are rarely seen in open court and are feared for their godlike power.

title: Antediluvian
content: The progenitors of the clans, from the time before the Great Flood. They are the sleeping gods of the Kindred, whose waking brings Gehenna.

title: Autarkis
content: A vampire who refuses to join the Camarilla or any other sect, living on the fringes of society. They claim no rights and offer no allegiance.

title: Caitiff
content: A vampire of no clan. They are treated as second-class citizens or worse, often rounded up by the Scourge or used as scapegoats.

title: Thin-Blood
content: A vampire of high generation (14th/15th) with weak blood. They are viewed as harbingers of Gehenna and are often hunted or barred from the city.

title: Ghoul
content: A mortal servant fed vampire blood. They serve as daylight agents, bodyguards, and retainers. They are considered property of their domitor.

title: Domitor
content: The vampire master of a ghoul. They hold the blood bond and command the ghoul's loyalty.

title: Sire
content: The vampire who created another. Under the Tradition of Accounting, they are responsible for their childe's education and behavior.

title: Childe
content: The progeny of a vampire. Until released, they are the responsibility of their sire.

title: Brood
content: A group of vampires sired by the same vampire. They are 'siblings' in blood.

title: Lineage
content: The genealogy of a vampire, tracing back to the Antediluvian. Ventrue and Lasombra place immense value on reciting and documenting lineage.

title: Regent (Tremere)
content: The leader of a local Tremere Chantry. They govern the Warlocks of the city and report to the Lord or Pontifex of the region.

title: Pontifex
content: A high-ranking Tremere leader overseeing a vast geographic region (consisting of several domains). They answer to the Council of Seven.

title: Lord (Tremere)
content: A Tremere rank above Regent but below Pontifex. They oversee a cluster of Chantries.

title: Apprentice
content: A Tremere rank for a neonate or ancilla who has not yet achieved the rank of Regent. There are seven circles of apprenticeship.

title: Primogen Council
content: The collective body of Primogen. They meet to vote on domain issues, advise the Prince, and in some cities, elect the Prince.

title: The Directorate
content: A term sometimes used for the Ventrue board of elders who direct clan policy within a city or region.

title: Pyramid
content: The rigid hierarchical structure of Clan Tremere. Every member has a specific rank and superior they must obey.

title: Spearman
content: A slang term (often derogatory) for a ghoul or low-ranking neonate used as cannon fodder or muscle.

title: Seneschal's Whip
content: A rare title for an assistant specifically to the Seneschal, handling administrative enforcement rather than clan matters.

title: Regent
content: The supreme leader of the Sabbat, ruling in the name of Caine. They interpret the Book of Nod and set the spiritual and military direction of the entire sect. They rule from Mexico City.

title: Cardinal
content: A high-ranking Sabbat leader who oversees a vast geographic region (e.g., the East Coast). They coordinate war efforts, sieges, and the movements of Archbishops. They hold a seat on the Consistory.

title: Archbishop
content: The ruler of a Sabbat city or domain. Unlike a Prince, their rule is often shared with a council of Bishops, though they are the ultimate authority in military and spiritual matters for that city.

title: Bishop
content: A lieutenant to an Archbishop or a leader of a specific aspect of the city's governance (e.g., Bishop of War, Bishop of the Faith). They advise the Archbishop and command respect from local packs.

title: Priscus
content: An advisor of immense status but technically no command authority. They form the 'Consistory' that advises the Regent and Cardinals. Packs often seek their wisdom or patronage.

title: The Consistory
content: The governing council of the Sabbat, comprised of Cardinals and Prisci. They advise the Regent and help steer the Sword of Caine.

title: Ductus
content: The tactical leader of a Sabbat pack. Chosen by the pack (not appointed from above), they make the combat decisions and decide the pack's immediate goals.

title: Pack Priest
content: The spiritual leader of a Sabbat pack. They conduct the Auctoritas Ritae (like the Vaulderie) and ensure the pack remains loyal to the sect and true to their Path of Enlightenment.

title: Abbot
content: The pack member responsible for the maintenance, security, and logistics of the communal haven. They ensure the pack has blood, weapons, and a safe place to sleep.

title: Templar (Paladin)
content: An elite warrior sworn to protect a specific leader (Bishop, Archbishop, Cardinal). They are the bodyguards and executioners of the Sabbat hierarchy, answering only to their charge.

title: Inquisitor
content: A member of the Sabbat Inquisition. They investigate infernalism and treason within the sect. They have the authority to accuse and try even high-ranking leaders.

title: Grand Inquisitor
content: The head of the Sabbat Inquisition. A terrifying figure who directs the hunt for infernalists and heretics across the entire sect.

title: Judge Inquisitor
content: A high-ranking Inquisitor authorized to convene tribunals and pass judgment on suspected traitors or infernalists.

title: Knight Inquisitor
content: The martial arm of the Inquisition. They hunt down those accused by the Judges and drag them to trial (or destroy them if they resist).

title: The Black Hand (Faction)
content: A secret military sub-sect within the Sabbat. They are the special forces of the Sword of Caine, dedicated to the most dangerous missions and the protection of the sect's oldest secrets.

title: Seraph
content: One of the four supreme commanders of the Black Hand. They answer only to the Regent (and technically the Consistory, though this is debated).

title: Dominion
content: A mid-level commander in the Black Hand, leading a 'Kamut' (a pack of Black Hand operatives).

title: Cadet
content: A recruit in training for the Black Hand. They must survive rigorous trials to become a full member.

title: True Sabbat
content: A vampire who has proven themselves to the sect (usually after surviving their Creation Rites and first siege). They are full members with the right to speak in council.

title: False Sabbat
content: A vampire who claims membership but has not yet proven themselves (or is suspected of treason). They have no rights and are often used as cannon fodder.

title: Shovelhead
content: A slang term for a mass-embraced vampire, created by being drained, fed blood, hit with a shovel, and buried. If they claw their way out, they join the siege. Most die or are destroyed.

title: Cainite
content: The preferred term Sabbat vampires use for themselves, emphasizing their descent from Caine and rejection of their human past (unlike 'Kindred').

title: Noddist
content: A scholar of the Book of Nod. They study the lore of Caine and the Antediluvians, seeking signs of Gehenna.

title: Keeper of the Code
content: A title sometimes given to a vampire (often a Priest or Priscus) renowned for their knowledge of the Code of Milan and Sabbat law.

title: War Party Leader
content: A temporary title for a vampire leading a 'War Party' hunt. They have absolute authority during the hunt.

title: Wild Hunt Leader
content: A temporary title for a vampire leading a 'Wild Hunt' against a traitor. They are deputized to destroy the target by any means necessary.

title: Loyalist (Faction)
content: A Sabbat member who believes in absolute freedom and rejects the hierarchy of Regents and Cardinals. They follow Caine's example of answering to no one.

title: Ultra-Conservative (Faction)
content: A Sabbat member who believes the sect needs strict military discipline and centralization to win the Gehenna War. They support the Regent and the hierarchy.

title: Status Quo (Faction)
content: A Sabbat member who supports the current balance of power (Lasombra/Tzimisce leadership) and the Code of Milan as it stands.

title: Pander (Title)
content: A member of the Pander bloodline (Clanless Sabbat). They have fought for and won the right to be treated as a legitimate tribe within the sect.

title: Tzimisce Voivode
content: An honorary title for a powerful Tzimisce elder, respecting their clan's feudal roots.

title: Lasombra Magister
content: An honorary title for a Lasombra who has mastered the shadows and the games of politics.

title: Pack
content: The fundamental social unit of the Sabbat. A group of vampires bound by the Vinculum (blood bond) who live, fight, and die together.

title: Nomad Pack
content: A Sabbat pack that travels from city to city, acting as messengers, scouts, or reinforcements. They have no permanent domain.

title: Founded Pack
content: A Sabbat pack that settles permanently in a city, establishing a communal haven and taking territory.

title: Kamut
content: A specific term for a pack comprised entirely of Black Hand operatives.

title: Siege Commander
content: A temporary title for the leader (often a Cardinal or Archbishop) directing a siege against a Camarilla city.

title: Liaison
content: A vampire appointed to communicate between different packs or factions within a city to ensure unity.

title: Scout
content: A pack role for the vampire best suited to reconnaissance and stealth.

title: Scholar
content: A pack role for the vampire who keeps the lore and knowledge of the pack (often the Priest, but not always).

title: Enforcer (Pack)
content: A pack role for the strongest combatant, responsible for physical threats to the pack.

title: Face (Pack)
content: A pack role for the vampire who handles social interactions with outsiders or other packs.

title: Harbinger
content: A messenger sent ahead of a nomadic pack or war party to announce their arrival (or issue threats).

title: Recruiter
content: A Sabbat vampire who specializes in identifying potential shovelheads or true recruits for the sect.

title: Ritualist
content: A vampire skilled in the performance of Ignoblis Ritae.

title: Cobbler
content: A Sabbat vampire (often Nosferatu) who creates fake identities and papers for the pack to move through mortal society.

title: Cleaner
content: A Sabbat vampire responsible for cleaning up the Masquerade breaches (or 'Silence of the Blood' breaches) left after a raid.

title: Dogcatcher
content: A slang term for a Sabbat vampire who specializes in hunting Lupines (werewolves) or gangrel antitribu who have gone feral.

title: Firewalker
content: A vampire who has passed the Fire Dance ritual and is respected for their bravery.

title: Path Follower
content: A vampire who has formally adopted a Path of Enlightenment, abandoning Humanity. They are viewed as more 'evolved' by the sect.

title: E.W. Grove (Keeper Emeritus)
content: Ventrue Ancilla and owner of the Grove Park Inn. Granted his wish to make the Inn an Elysium in June 2025 by Prince Daveed, shortly before being replaced as Keeper by Michael Valentine.

title: Sister Tiffany (Elder)
content: Malkavian Elder (acknowledged May 2025). A former nun and civil rights organizer who served as Harpy from 1992 to 2025. She resigned her post upon reaching Elder status.

title: Ken Dances
content: Reclusive Nosferatu Neonate and host of the pirate radio show 'The Weather'. He has not been seen at a Gather in decades, yet everyone knows his voice.

title: Zelda Fitzgerald (Asylum Seeker)
content: Toreador Childe of Tallula Donegan. Formerly the Sabbat Bishop of the Arts and Emissary. She sought asylum with the Camarilla on August 2nd, 2025, after Mallori Mayhem's rise.

title: (Petty) Baron Schaefer
content: Brujah Baron of Mars Hill. He holds a unique treaty allowing Sabbat members to store heretical books and artifacts in his library for safekeeping as a disinterested third party.

title: Archbishop Mallori Mayhem
content: Malkavian Antitribu. Former Archon to Cardinal Polonia. Claimed the Bloodbath on August 2nd, 2025, establishing a new Sabbat Archdiocese in the region.

title: Twist (Bishop)
content: Nosferatu antitribu. The Sabbat Bishop of Information in the new Mallori Mayhem Archdiocese.

title: Sawtooth Pete (Bishop)
content: Gangrel antitribu. The Sabbat Bishop of Resources. Former Camarilla Primogen who defected back to the Sword of Caine.

title: Merriam Walker (Bishop)
content: Ventrue antitribu. The Sabbat Bishop of Security in the new Archdiocese.

title: Lucien Blake (Bishop)
content: Lasombra. The Sabbat Bishop of Spirituality. A 'Book of Nod thumping evangelist' who distributes Chick tracts.

title: Dire (Bishop)
content: Gargoyle. The Sabbat Bishop of War. A terrifying combatant for the new Archdiocese.

title: Archon Tallula Donegan (Deceased?)
content: Toreador Elder. Named Archon in 2025 and sent to Argentina. Reportedly hurled from the Alvear Tower in Buenos Aires by the traitor Ana Maria Alverez on Nov 1, 2025.

title: Servire Svetlana Volshebnik
content: Tremere Elder. Accompanied Tallula to Argentina as her Servire. Reported Tallula's betrayal and death but holds out hope for her survival.

title: Ana Maria Alverez (Traitor)
content: Lasombra Elder. Betrayed Archon Tallula in Argentina, declared herself Baron of Rosario, and claimed credit for killing the Archon.

title: Big Ben (Destroyed)
content: Elder of unknown clan. Former Seneschal. Bloodhunted by Prince Daveed and destroyed by Elara (Brujah) on July 5th, 2025.

title: Magda Doluda (Deceased)
content: Banu Haqim Ancilla and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Dec 7, 2024. Safeguarded the Ukrainian population of Asheville.

title: Sadie (Deceased)
content: Brujah Elder and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Jan 4, 2025. Former Harpy of Charlotte who moved to Asheville in 2001.

title: Johannan Wilder (Deceased)
content: Gangrel Ancilla and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Jan 4, 2025. Local expert on Lupines and a known romantic poet.

title: Hattie McCloud (Deceased)
content: Malkavian Ancilla and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Dec 7, 2024. Owner of the Rabbit Motel. Known for 'special vintages' of blood.

title: funnyM0rray (Missing)
content: Nosferatu Neonate and former Primogen. Missing since Dec 7, 2024. A darling of the domain known for her love of fandoms.

title: Miles Wilkins (Deceased)
content: Toreador Neonate and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Jan 4, 2025. Rumored to have paid for his seat. Obsessed with fantasy football.

title: Tyrell Jackson (Deceased)
content: Ventrue Ancilla and former Primogen. Ashes recovered Jan 4, 2025. A sports fan who prided himself on being an 'average guy'.

title: Rex the Dick (Destroyed)
content: Brujah antitribu. Former Sabbat Bishop of Pride. Slain June 7, 2025. Ran a biker gang in Canton.

title: Winter (Destroyed)
content: Toreador antitribu. Former Sabbat Emissary. Slain May 3, 2025. Ductus of the 150 Guns pack.

title: Rabbit Motel
content: A boutique motel run by the late Hattie McCloud. Known for its kitchen and serving kindred clientele.

title: Alvear Tower
content: The tallest building in Argentina. The site of Tallula Donegan's alleged final death.

title: Mars Hill Library
content: The massive collection of heretical lore kept by Baron Schaefer in Mars Hill.

title: Biltmore No-Go Zone
content: The strict edict that no Kindred may enter the Biltmore Estate. It acts as a memorial to the tyrant Prince Evander and is enforced by a fragile treaty with the Lupines.

title: Grove House (Nightlife)
content: A location originally a YWCA, now a hub for Kindred nightlife. Despite the name, it is not owned by E.W. Grove, but was controlled by Prince Tallula Donegan as a public meeting space.

title: Renovations (Grove Arcade)
content: The official reason given by Prince Daveed Fourié for stripping the Grove Arcade of its Elysium status on December 3rd, 2025. Likely a euphemism for a security breach or political shift.

title: Wall Street Tunnels
content: A network of tunnels underneath Wall Street in Asheville, emphasized as being more extensive and dangerous in the World of Darkness setting than in the real world.

title: Chronicle Theme: Religious Trauma
content: A specific theme explored in the game due to the setting's Sabbat history, acknowledging that much of the Sabbat's iconography and control mechanisms are twisted from Catholic trappings.

title: Chronicle Theme: Isolation
content: A central theme of the chronicle, reflecting the geography of the mountains and the political isolation of a Camarilla domain surrounded by Sabbat and Anarch territories.

title: Chicken Alley
content: A local Asheville landmark mentioned as existing in the darker Greater Asheville setting, implying the inclusion of local urban legends in the game's atmosphere.

title: Basilica Catacombs
content: The hidden depths beneath the Basilica of St. Lawrence. In this setting, they run much deeper than mortals know and serve as secure meeting points or shelters during sieges.

title: Schaefer's Fiefdom
content: The autonomous Anarch domain centered around Mars Hill University. It is known for hosting a library of texts that would be destroyed by the Camarilla for their heretical or dangerous nature.

title: The Zeitgeist
content: The narrative direction of the chronicle, which focuses on growing past Sabbat traditions. Characters seeking to return to the Sabbat are noted to be at odds with the fundamental themes of the game.

title: Unacknowledged Feeding
content: The specific prohibition against allowing Unacknowledged Kindred to feed within a Clan's assigned territory. It is the Clan's responsibility to police this, not just the Sheriff's.

title: June 2025 Praxis Shift
content: The specific date when Prince Daveed Fourié claimed Praxis, resulting in the shuffling of Elysium locations (opening Grove Arcade, closing the Arboretum).
